claim: Vera Total Reality Test (Phase 1 — Level 0 inventory + the finite scenario matrix + Level-1 critical journeys). The master testing/observation foundation: it DISCOVERS the real product — surfaces (the real web pages + the server route that serves each), controls (parsed from the real HTML), API routes (parsed from the real server), and feature contracts (the product's claims) — then REDUCES the infinite phrasing space into the finite Total Scenario Matrix (anima/scenarios/: schema axes, inventory discovery, generator equivalence-class reduction). The directive's three hard rules are enforced with teeth: every visible control has >= 1 scenario, every feature contract (claim) maps to a scenario, and every scenario is fully classified across the 14 axes (no UNKNOWN axis, no unclassified user behaviour). The Level-1 critical journeys (fresh chat, add knowledge, ask-from-source, forget memory, consent revoke, approval queue, lockdown, trust ledger, host health) are real user paths whose deterministic critical/immune proof runs through the existing synthetic-user Rover (scripts/vera_rover.py --selftest). Served + auth-gated Control Room (Coverage panel): GET /reality serves the page, GET /reality.json rides behind the Face ID seam, computed live from the real product. Read-only. Phase 1 of a multi-phase program; Levels 2-9 (full surface / permission / data / state / pairwise / renegade / soak / fuzz) are honestly deferred to the next phases.
owner: anima/scenarios/ (schema.py the 14 axes + Scenario object, inventory.py REAL surface/control/route/contract discovery, generator.py equivalence-class scenario-matrix generation), scripts/generate_total_scenario_matrix.py (emits the Level-0 report bundle), anima/server.py (_total_reality_data + GET /reality + GET /reality.json), anima/web/reality.html (the Coverage Control Room: inventory + matrix + hard-rule status), scripts/certify_total_reality.py

killer_test.name: real_product_inventory_and_finite_scenario_matrix_with_hard_rules
killer_test.setup: scripts/certify_total_reality.py proves the inventory is REAL (surfaces/controls/routes/contracts discovered from the live product; every surface file exists and is served), enforces the hard rules with teeth (NO unmapped visible control — every control has a scenario; NO unclassified behaviour — every scenario fully classified; every feature contract maps to a scenario), proves the Level-1 critical journeys exist and the Rover's deterministic critical proof passes, and — the keystone — the coverage check BITES (a synthetic control with no scenario is detected as an unmapped gap; a coverage check that can't detect a gap is wallpaper). The matrix + inventory + coverage report bundle writes well-formed, and the coverage rides through _total_reality_data + GET /reality.
killer_test.prompt: open /reality — the real product (surfaces, controls, routes, claims) inventoried, reduced to a finite scenario matrix, with every control mapped and every scenario classified

known_gaps: Phase 1 delivers Level 0 (real inventory + the finite scenario matrix with the hard rules enforced) and Level 1 (the critical journeys, executed via the existing Rover's deterministic proof). The remaining phases are honestly deferred and queued: Level 2 full surface/control execution via the live Rover, Levels 3-5 permission/consent/data/state coverage, Level 6 pairwise combinatorial, Level 7 Renegade integrated stress chains, Level 8 long-session/soak, Level 9 fuzz/randomised Rover; plus the full Observation Harness evidence-bundle correlator, the Renegade engine, the per-persona Rover, and the live Control Room run/perf/security panels.
